name: [SOC/UEBA] Brute force – many failed logons to one account from one host
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and event.outcome=="Fail" and user.kind=="human"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(10minutes, @timestamp) | stats event_count=count() by timebucket, user.name, source.host
| where event_count >= 150
description: Một máy thử mật khẩu liên tục cho cùng một tài khoản người trong 10 phút. – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
false_positives: Người dùng gõ sai mật khẩu đã lưu trong ứng dụng/dịch vụ

name: [SOC/UEBA] Password spraying – one host failing logons to many accounts
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and event.outcome=="Fail" and user.kind=="human"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(10minutes, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(user.name) by timebucket, source.host
| where value_count >= 20
description: Password spraying – one host failing logons to many accounts – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
false_positives: terminal server) nhiều người gõ sai mật khẩu

name: [SOC/UEBA] Pass-the-Hash – human account NTLM logons to many hosts within 1 hour
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and auth.type=="NTLM" and logon.type=="Network" and network.remote==true and user.kind=="human" and event.outcome=="Success"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1hours, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(destination.host) by timebucket, user.name
| where value_count >= 10
description:
Dùng hash NTLM đánh cắp để xác thực mạng hàng loạt (MITRE T1550.002). Người dùng bình thường chủ yếu dùng Kerberos và chỉ chạm vài máy chủ quen.
 – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
false_positives: ứng dụng cũ không hỗ trợ Kerberos

name: [SOC/UEBA] Lateral movement – human account logs on to very many hosts within 1 hour
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and (logon.type in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")) and network.remote==true and user.kind=="human" and event.outcome=="Success" and event.action=="LogOn"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1hours, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(destination.host) by timebucket, user.name
| where value_count >= 40
description: Lateral movement – human account logs on to very many hosts within 1 hour – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA

name: [SOC/UEBA] Many human accounts logging on from the same host within 1 hour
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and (logon.type in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")) and network.remote==true and user.kind=="human" and event.outcome=="Success" and event.action=="LogOn"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1hours, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(user.name) by timebucket, source.host
| where value_count >= 25
description:
Máy cá nhân chỉ có 1–2 người dùng. Một máy xác thực mạng bằng nhiều tài khoản người là dấu hiệu kẻ tấn công dùng credential thu thập được (T1078) – không phụ thuộc lịch sử nên không bị "đầu độc baseline" khi kẻ tấn công ở lâu.
 – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
false_positives: Terminal server / Citrix / máy chủ ứng dụng chuyển tiếp xác thực

name: [SOC/UEBA] Activity from a host confirmed as attacker (IOC)
query:
from soc-events-lanl metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="lanl.auth" and source.host=="__no_ioc__" and user.kind=="human"
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_count=count() by timebucket, user.name, source.host
| where event_count >= 1
description: IOC do analyst xác nhận từ incident trước (vòng phản hồi SOC). – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
